page.overview:
What is Secret Fire?

The Flame Imperishable, also called the Secret Fire and Airefëa, was a mysterious, eternal, divine power of Eru Ilúvatar, used by him to create and animate Eä (the whole world) and its inhabitants.

This power was with Ilúvatar exclusively from the very beginning and was an aspect of his being. Thus, when Melkor sought for it, his efforts were in vain. Later, Ilúvatar sent the Secret Fire at the heart of Eä.

It is also described as being part of all Fëa, the soul of a living being or the spirit, or the Gift that made sentient beings capable of independent thought and will, for though other beings within Arda could create to a greater or lesser extent, even the Valar could not bring new life into being that is independent from Eru's own design (beings could, for instance, procreate, but could not give life as Eru could). This lack of ability to bring into being ideas of his own was what initially led Melkor down the path of Darkness, for he wished above all else to order the universe in accordance with his own desires, and defy the will of Eru.
